about.title: About me
about.bio: Data Engineer with {{yearsInIT}}+ years in software engineering and a data engineering focus since 2023, working for US and Singapore businesses in B2B distribution, healthcare, and pharma. Builds ELT pipelines with Apache Airflow, Airbyte, and dbt on Snowflake and BigQuery, LLM-powered data enrichment, and the Metabase and Tableau reporting on top, including reconciliation behind 200+ recurring reports. As a software engineer, builds REST APIs and serverless AWS backends in Python and Java (25% lower infrastructure cost) and web front ends in Angular and React.
about.bioSe: Software Engineer with {{yearsInIT}}+ years building backend services, REST APIs, and web applications for US and Singapore businesses. Builds Python and Java backends (Flask, Spring Boot), including a move from Flask servers to serverless AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, S3) that cut infrastructure cost by about 25%, and web front ends in Angular and React. Since 2023 also builds LLM-powered pipelines and tools, and data platforms with Apache Airflow and dbt on Snowflake and BigQuery, with infrastructure as code (OpenTofu) and workloads on Kubernetes.

augur.title: Augur: Threat-Hunting & Risk Validation
augur.subtitle: Personal Project
augur.desc: Deterministic, AI-free engine that ingests security logs, projects them onto a temporal knowledge graph, and scores how far known attack scenarios have progressed, with ready-to-run KQL/Sigma hunting queries.
bullets: Built a deterministic engine that ingests multi-OS security logs into a temporal knowledge graph and scores how far each known attack scenario has progressed.
Generated explainable, ranked verdicts with ready-to-run KQL/Sigma hunting queries, plus a React console, RBAC and alerting around the engine.

discode.title: Discode: AI Coding Assistants in Discord
discode.subtitle: Personal Project · Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker
discode.desc: Discord bot platform that turns AI coding CLIs (Claude, Codex, OpenCode) into stateful, thread-based chat sessions, spawning a fresh subprocess per message.
bullets: Built a Discord bot platform that runs AI coding CLIs (Claude, Codex, OpenCode and others) as stateful, thread-based chat sessions, keeping multi-turn context via per-tool resume tokens.
Designed a multi-process architecture (bot, runner, dispatcher) on shared PostgreSQL and Redis, using an outbox and idempotent job claims for reliable delivery.
Ran each turn in a short-lived subprocess so a crashed tool never takes down a session, and kept platform secrets out of the tools' environment.
cvBullets: Built a Discord bot platform that runs AI coding CLIs (Claude, Codex, OpenCode) as stateful, thread-based chat sessions.
Designed a multi-process bot/runner/dispatcher on PostgreSQL and Redis with an outbox and idempotent job claims.

Implemented streaming protocol adapters, model discovery, tool permissions, and versioned JSON and Google Drive snapshot backups with validated imports.
Set up CI that runs type checks, a deterministic Vitest regression suite and a dependency audit before every deployment.
cvBullets: Built a PWA chat client for OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, and Ollama APIs in React 19, TypeScript, and Zustand.

Developed pipelines for job description generation, candidate ingestion, and LLM-based CV parsing (OpenAI, Anthropic) across multiple submission sources, with semantic candidate matching on embeddings in pgvector.
